name: Jaesa Willsaam's corvette
description: Jedi Padawan Jaesa Willsaam flew a corvette that was similar to the Defender-class light corvette before joining Darth Baras's apprentice. While visually identical to the Defender-class, her ship was twice as large and featured a radically different layout.
